digest.component_or_area: CLI bridge noun and subcommand dispatch
propositions: Bridge noun with functional preview (read-only, no mutation) and sync (mutating) subcommands must ship without breaking legacy reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, or rebar doctor commands
Callers cannot pass --mode or --filter-local-ids through bridge preview/sync to override the read/write distinction enforced by the command choice
Mode.py MODE_CAPS and Mode rank ladder must remain intact for MCP surface and gated_mode: reconcile-check phase-gate compatibility
Six downstream stories depend on this ticket to attach their verbs (pause, resume, status, check-access, fsck, setup) to the bridge surface once their functional implementations are ready

Nested bridge subcommand dispatch must prevent sibling verbs from being advertised before their handlers land and must cause unknown verbs to fail explicitly rather than fall through to top-level commands
Generated CLI reference, user guide, and release notes must document only the staged surface (preview, sync, and preserved legacy commands) without advertising unimplemented placeholder verbs
